posts.name: trudge
posts.cooked:
Which five heroes would be most appropriate for a street-level vigilante team?  This team would be thematically matched for Rook City, and for battling villains like the Chairman and Spite.

 

Rook City Wraith, Mister Fixer, and Expatriette seem like the obvious choices, but who else would fit in that team?  Chrono-Ranger?  Nightmist?  Unity?

There's two other angles on Absolute Zero that makes him a compelling choice: 1) he got his power from an accident at Pike Laboratories, and 2) he closely resembles Mr. Freeze, a Batman villain.  Also, he's pretty morally ambiguous.

I really like the idea of a "Rook City Irregulars" consisting of Wraith, Mister Fixer, Absolute Zero, Expatriette, and Nightmist.  It's a very gritty team.

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
Theta_Sigma:

Doesn't Chrono-Ranger just hate rat monsters, though? And The Matriarch is Tachyon's cousin

I think the point is that they have a direct connection to big aspects of Rook City:  The villains.  Chrono-Ranger is trying to claim a bounty on the Ur-Rat Beast that stole his arm and overran the world, turning it into the Final Wasteland.  Tachyon has a younger cousin obsessed with undermining her because her parents compared their emotionally disturbed teenage daughter to a very successful superhero superscientist in her late thirties.  Bad move.

I think what we can take from this is that there are layers to the "most thematic" five person team to take to Rook City.  A Plague Rat party just wouldn't feel complete without Chrono, and The Matriarch would be screeching about her cousin joining the brawl while her birds stole every shiny thing that wasn't nailed down.  But The Organization may not require Chrono or Tachyon's involvement at all.
I'd say that the appropriate Rook City group would be bigger than five, with certain subsets and side characters that could be included in certain situations (like the rap supergroup Hieroglyphics, except RC Wraith/Fixer/Expat are Souls of Mischief and Chrono-Ranger is Del Tha Funkee Homosapien).

I think the better question is who would feel out of place in an exclusively Rook City themed team?

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
A few of my thoughts
 
 
Superman does not fit in in Gotham, Leagacy does not fit in in Rook City. He's larger than life, too bright and colourful to fit in dark corners people need to go to get the real information in Rook City. I don't think people would even go get his autograph for fear of being seen with him.
 
Bunker's the military, you rarely deploy the army to your urban centres unless you can avoid it, too much collateral damage. Even out of the suit he seems to straight laced. Now Engine of war (after he reforms), I can see him in Rook City getting his hands all dirty...
 
Tachyon looks more at home in a clean, sterile lab-like environment, that is definitely not a description of Rook City.
 
When I think of Tempest in ROok City, I picture him causing floods in the streets, to try and wash away the scum collecting on the streets, or at least causing them to duck into bars for a time.
 
While I'm not sure they would be great in Rook Ciy, I would love to see Absolute Zero and Omnitron-X trying to "fit in" by wearing trench coats and fedoras to cover their bulky frames!
